question: Among the 12 source+occupancy observationally equivalent worlds with differing lag2 synthetic maturity, which additional pre-present occupancy time and site observations discriminate that target, excluding tautological direct measurement of its age-threshold target?

source.already_exposed_geometry_of_12: all clustered-source rook-neighborhood based on reviewed v42 CSV; NOT independently blinded or causal

world_design.simulator: same exact v23, v41 and v42 source graph, three activation histories and first-arrival times; all 768 worlds used for checks, 12 irreducible v42 mature-state worlds scored
world_design.baseline_information: exact original four non-source occupancy snapshots plus all perfect earliest-source tags at every non-source node (optimistic upper bound)
world_design.present_horizon: same v26 T*=max first arrival over all non-source nodes and three candidate histories
world_design.ecological_target: same v26 binary persistent_threshold_lag2: mature iff first_arrival<=T*-2; source-site nodes excluded
world_design.time_domain: all integer times t from 0 to T* inclusive, do not access t>T*
observation_modes: one complete additional non-source-node occupancy census at a time t
one individual non-source-node binary presence readout at a time t
set of individual binary node-time measurements with minimal-cardinality coverage of remaining target-different candidate-history pairs
world_design.candidate_outcome_definition: true-history-specific binary 1[first_arrival(node)<=t] only, no noisy field detections
world_design.candidate_history_prior: uniform over all three original histories; baseline conditioning on complete ideal source label and original occupancy signature
world_design.selection_not_truth_leakage: candidate-history signatures and target-equivalence classes may guide an oracle design, but the actual true-history identity/observed reports are NOT used to select events

primary_non_tautological.why_exclude: a full perfect occupancy census at t=T*-2 is definitionally IDENTICAL to the synthetic lag2 mature-state target at T*, hence not independent prediction evidence
primary_non_tautological.one_optimally_selected_census: select earliest t maximizing conditional mutual information about target given complete initial observation and uniform candidate history prior, return predicted exact resolution and max bits; use stable chronological ties
primary_non_tautological.earliest_single_binary: select earliest t then node ID among all exact one-probe target-resolving candidates; classification is model-aided oracle not a prospective field schedule
primary_non_tautological.minimal_binary_set_cover: exact deterministic bitmask shortest-set-cover over target-discordant pairs of baseline-equivalent histories; tie-break by number of measurements then time then node ID
primary_non_tautological.unidentifiable: report inability of the entire allowed perfect non-tautological observation library to distinguish current target; never guess

positive_tautology_control.expected: perfect complete census at T*-2 directly encodes each mature-state bit; exact rescue of all 12 must be reported explicitly as definitional

control_original_times.expected_conditional_information_about_m: zero, as already part of baseline
control_original_times.when_after_present_horizon: do not treat future census as existing baseline information

metrics.information_definition: I(maturity target; perfect extra readout | initial 4 occupancy and complete perfect source tag library), same original uniform three-history prior; no new Bayesian parameter fitting
metrics.resolution_definition: all target-discordant history pairs within any baseline-equivalence class distinguishable by chosen observations
main_outputs: per-scenario source geometry, neighborhood, mature-state alternative target counts, Tstar, non-tautological census / sentinel rescue, minimum binary events, identity-census control, fixed calendar applicability
exact posterior information and Bayes target-error reductions, conditional on old complete source tags
metrics.privacy: synthetic node IDs and world scenario keys only; no individual bird/geographic data

predeclared_testable_predictions.rule: all 12 residual worlds are resolved by perfect full census at t=T*-2 (a mathematical positive control, not new ecology)
at least one of 12 is resolved by a single non-tautological extra full census time t (may be REFUTED)
at least one of 12 is resolved by one non-tautological binary node×time presence reading (may be REFUTED)
at least one of 12 needs at least 2 non-tautological node×time binary readings for exact maturity-target identification (may be REFUTED)
repeating any original snapshot time at or before T* contributes 0 conditional target information (structural negative control)

mandatory_checks: v41 complete canonical original source rerun SHA256 exact
v42 previous original CSV classification 141/36/12 reconciled without copying individual biological observations
12 residual worlds exact from 768 unchanged latent graph scenarios; all three activation histories
perfect-all source aliases not silently dropped
no timestamp Tstar-2 treated as non-tautological independent predictor
zero information for source+occupancy baseline re-observation
all original v42/CIs/maturity target process and EOG-WF closure unchanged
report all five original prediction verdicts including REFUTED
